activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

gross_increase_count.help: Number of assets made to increase the value of the asset

total_depreciation_entries_count.help: Number of depreciation entries (posted or not)

country_code.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

state.help:
When an asset is created, the status is 'Draft'.
If the asset is confirmed, the status goes in 'Running' and the depreciation lines can be posted in the accounting.
The 'On Hold' status can be set manually when you want to pause the depreciation of an asset for some time.
You can manually close an asset when the depreciation is over.
By cancelling an asset, all depreciation entries will be reversed

method.help:
Choose the method to use to compute the amount of depreciation lines.
  * Straight Line: Calculated on basis of: Gross Value / Duration
  * Declining: Calculated on basis of: Residual Value * Declining Factor
  * Declining then Straight Line: Like Declining but with a minimum depreciation value equal to the straight line value.

method_number.help: The number of depreciations needed to depreciate your asset

method_period.help: The amount of time between two depreciations
method_period.string: Number of Months in a Period

prorata_date.help: Starting date of the period used in the prorata calculation of the first depreciation

account_asset_id.help: Account used to record the purchase of the asset at its original price.

account_depreciation_id.help: Account used in the depreciation entries, to decrease the asset value.

account_depreciation_expense_id.help: Account used in the periodical entries, to record a part of the asset as expense.

book_value.help: Sum of the depreciable value, the salvage value and the book value of all value increase items

salvage_value.help: It is the amount you plan to have that you cannot depreciate.

salvage_value_pct.help: It is the amount you plan to have that you cannot depreciate.

account_type.help: Account Type is used for information purpose, to generate country-specific legal reports, and set the rules to close a fiscal year and generate opening entries.

parent_id.help: An asset has a parent when it is the result of gaining value

children_ids.help: The children are the gains in value of this asset

already_depreciated_amount_import.help: In case of an import from another software, you might need to use this field to have the right depreciation table report. This is the value that was already depreciated with entries not computed from this model

net_gain_on_sale.help: Net value of gain or loss on sale of an asset

responsible_id.help: (365 custom) ผู้รับผิดชอบสินทรัพย์

asset_location_id.help: (365 custom) แผนกงาน/สถานที่เก็บสินทรัพย์

asset_register_number.string: เลขทะเบียนคุม FIX ASSET

related_asset_ids.help: Link other assets that should be considered together.

child_asset_ids.help: Quickly manage the children of this asset without opening each child.

is_parent_asset.help: Technical flag to mark assets that have children.

is_child_asset.help: Technical flag to mark assets that have a parent.

has_child_assets.help: Technical flag to mark assets that have children.

hierarchy_related_asset_ids.help: Shows children if they exist, otherwise the parent asset.

total_group_value.help: Sum of original value of this parent asset and all its children.
